editorial:
Deep in Jakarta's slums, an elite SWAT team storms a rundown apartment block to catch a drug lord, but the mission goes wrong fast. You follow Rama, a skilled officer played by Iko Uwais, as he fights through floors packed with killers, gangsters, and traps. The story is simple and direct, but the tension never lets up. Every hallway feels dangerous, and the movie keeps you locked in from the first raid to the last punch. If you want a crime thriller with nonstop action, this one delivers.

The martial arts scenes are the big draw, with sharp choreography, brutal fights, and a pace that barely slows down. Uwais is convincing as both a fighter and a man trying to survive, while the villains feel threatening without much talking. The downside is that the plot is thin and some characters are barely developed, so do not expect deep drama. Still, action fans will love it. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Rama fights his way to the top floor and faces the drug lord's top enforcer in a brutal showdown. After winning, he confronts the drug lord, but the mission is already falling apart around him. Rama escapes the building with a wounded teammate and learns his brother is connected to the crime world. The twist is that the raid was partly a setup, and the real danger was inside his own team. He leaves alive, but the victory feels costly and uncertain.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves nonstop action and martial arts fights.
